content: {"like":["Values high-quality visual and audio presentation, especially anamorphic formats and vivid HDR;","Prefers comprehensive special features and bonus content on multi-disc releases;","Appreciates films with strong thematic depth, inspirational messages, and historical significance;","Enjoys detailed archival material and interviews that enrich documentary storytelling;","Seeks multilingual subtitles and diverse language options for accessibility."],"dislike":["Dislikes inconsistencies in runtime information and discrepancies between advertised and actual lengths;","Finds it frustrating when films are speeded up or altered, compromising the original pacing;","Prefers original scores and audio mixes, rejecting versions that omit key musical elements;","Avoids releases that omit significant special features or extras;","Values authenticity and accuracy in film presentation, rejecting edits that change the intended experience."]}
